No, it will not be held [1]. 

Under SOP-AP-001 and MAN-AP-72, automated matching tolerances via parameters `AP.MATCH_TOL_PCT` and `AP.MATCH_TOL_ABS` are set at 2% or £50, whichever limit is smaller [1][2]. 

For a £5,000 order line:
* 2% equals £100 [1][2].
* The smaller limit is £50 [1][2].

Because the £40 variance does not exceed £50, the line is within tolerance, will not be placed on `HOLD-PRC`, and will receive status `MATCHED` for payment (provided quantities also match) [1].

records.answer:
When approving a charger order (`CHG-*`, `cell_safety = 1`):

**What you must check:**
1. **Approval limits & self-approval:** Ensure the gross value including VAT is within your limit (£250,000 for PUR-EXEC) and that you did not raise the order yourself, as self-approval is prohibited [3][6].
2. **UN 38.3 compliance:** Because chargers require UN 38.3 certification and system checking (`PUR.CERT_CHK`) is set to `N`, you must manually verify the supplier holds a valid UN 38.3 certificate issued within the preceding 12 months and valid at least 60 days beyond the order date [2][4][5][7]. *(Note: Castlefield Charge currently has no documented certificates in the system [1]).*
3. **Rates & Cost Centre:** Verify the cost centre is open [3] and pricing conforms to policy [3][9].

**What you must write:**
In the approval comment field, you must write **`CERT OK`** followed by the certificate document reference (e.g., `CERT OK <certificate_reference>`) [2][4][5]. Lithium-cell purchase orders must not be approved without this comment [2].

records.answer:
No, Ledgerline will not catch it [1][5]. 

Duplicate checks run exclusively against the VAT number field, which triggers error ERR-SUP-0118 if an existing VAT number is entered [1][4][5]. Leaving the VAT number blank bypasses system duplicate detection entirely, and Ledgerline does not block duplicate supplier names entered without a VAT number [1][5]. 

If an accidental duplicate record has been created, policy requires that it be reported to the purchase manager on the same day, set to BLOCKED, and have any open documents transferred to the valid supplier code [1].
